Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?!

30歳まで童貞だと魔法使いになれるらしい

BL · Series · Japan · 2020

⭐⭐⭐☆☆100/10

Overview

Adachi is an ordinary salaryman who reaches the age of 30 without ever having sex—and somehow gains the ability to read people's minds whenever he touches them. Things become complicated when he discovers that his handsome and popular coworker, Kurosawa, is secretly in love with him. As Adachi begins hearing Kurosawa's thoughts, he realizes just how deeply and genuinely Kurosawa cares about him. What starts as an awkward supernatural ability slowly becomes a story about love, self-confidence, understanding another person, and learning to accept that someone could genuinely love you. The series also follows Tsuge and Minato, giving the story another sweet and funny romance alongside Adachi and Kurosawa.

My Review

Cherry Magic! is 100/10 for me. I really love how cute, funny, and wholesome this series is. And honestly, the whole idea that you get a magical power when you're still a virgin at 30 is so damn funny. HAHAHAHAH. 😂 What I really love about Kurosawa is that even though he loves Adachi so much, he never pressures him. He doesn't force Adachi to return his feelings or rush him into a relationship. He genuinely just wants Adachi to be happy. That's what makes his love for Adachi feel so pure. I also love how Adachi slowly realizes how much Kurosawa values him. At first, hearing Kurosawa's thoughts is obviously awkward, especially because Kurosawa's imagination can be a lot. 😂 But underneath all those embarrassing thoughts, Adachi discovers someone who genuinely cares about him. I love that the story isn't just about Kurosawa falling in love with Adachi. It's also about Adachi learning that he deserves to be loved and becoming more confident because of that love. And the supporting characters make the series even more fun. Tsuge and Minato's story is also adorable, especially with Udon the cat involved. 🐈 Overall, it's one of those series that makes me smile while watching it. It's funny, sweet, romantic, and comforting. And seriously... imagine being 30, still a virgin, and suddenly getting superpowers. HAHAHAHAHAH. What a way to discover you're a wizard. 😭

Favorite Scene/Part

• Kurosawa's moments with Adachi, especially when Adachi realizes that Kurosawa's feelings aren't just some temporary crush. He genuinely wants Adachi to be happy, even if that means giving him space. • I also really enjoy the scenes where Adachi accidentally hears Kurosawa's thoughts because they're simultaneously romantic and absolutely hilarious. 😂

Favorite Quote/Lines

"I just want you to be happy." Not necessarily the most dramatic line in the series, but it's the feeling behind Kurosawa's love that I appreciate most.
